Settings.Name: Max zoom-out when exploring
Settings.Description: How far the camera can zoom out outside combat. The game's own limit is 12. Higher values show more of the area; indoors, the camera can then go above the ceiling. A change applies at once.

Settings.Name: Max zoom-out in combat
Settings.Description: How far the camera can zoom out during combat. The game's own limit is 15. The tactical view (overhead camera) keeps its own limit. A change applies at once.
